title: Visits Counted Against the Limit and the Waiver Date — Insured Plan of Care
content:
**Patient financial terms — Insured Plan of Care, advance waivers.**

**Visits counted.** The visits counted against the visit limit ahead of a waiver are the visits used elsewhere on file plus the visits the patient has had under the plan: the evaluation billed on the plan and the appointments attended on the plan's active Appointment Series. The visits left under the limit are the visit limit on file less the visits counted.

**The waiver's date.** The waiver's first date of service is today, the day the patient signs it.

## Worked count (hypothetical)

| Item | Visits |
|---|---|
| Calendar-year visit limit on file | 30 |
| Visits used elsewhere on file | 6 |
| Evaluation billed on the plan | 1 |
| Appointments attended on the active series | 20 |
| Visits counted | 27 |
| Visits left under the limit | 3 |

A waiver signed on 2026-07-14 under this count carries 2026-07-14 as its first date of service.
